tools.name: quote_fax
tools.description: Price one fax to a US or Canadian number before sending it. Returns both tiers: standard and priority, in cents and in USDC atomic units. Does not send the fax and does not charge.

tools.name: send_fax
tools.description: Send a PDF to a US or Canadian fax number. Pass an https pdf_url. Pay with Authorization: Bearer and a prepaid API key, or with the x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. priority true uses the priority price and is sent before other agent faxes. A website or app fax is still sent first. If neither payment

tools.name: get_fax_status
tools.description: Read one fax by id. Status is queued, sending, delivered or failed. Does not charge.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "send_fax" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
